display_name: Zone Theta shaft and Vault 002 threshold

reference_images.label: Approved Zone Theta vault wall
reference_images.instruction: match the wall's material and form exactly: curved organic planes with no edges, dark alloy with a faint crystalline sparkle, a network of circles and arcs like a star map just under the surface. Before the vault awakens the glyphs are only FAINT, not lit gold everywhere as here; the shaft is shallow (about eight meters) under the filtered canopy, not an open cathedral-scale pit

_reference_note: Approved 2026-11-14 for material and glyph network. Its glyph brightness and open-sky scale are not canon for the dormant wall.
